findings.quote: Nach Eingang der Zahlung kann die Bestellung nicht mehr storniert werden.
findings.rationale: Update this help text: it says cancellation is impossible after payment, but src/orders.mjs now explicitly allows paid orders: "export const mayCancel = (order) => ['unpaid', 'paid'].includes(order.phase);" This is current user-facing guidance, with no indication that it describes historical behavior.

limitations: Source-only review; tests were not run. Existing smoke assertions cover unpaid and shipped orders but do not verify the newly permitted paid case.
